blocks.text: BEIJING — From nuclear weapons to artificial intelligence, world leaders will tackle a range of issues when they gather in China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit this week. With all eyes on a crowning trilateral meeting between US, Chinese and Russian leaders on Thursday, AFP takes a look at the topics that may be discussed: Trade Trade tensions will loom over the economic leaders’ meeting, held from Wednesday to Thursday. US President Donald Trump has upended the global trade order by imposing wide-ranging tariffs on many countries, which China has met head-on with counter-levies and threats to withhold crucial […]...
